title: claude-status config
description: Configuration for the claude-status binary. Three layers, deep-merged low to high: the defaults embedded in the binary, ~/.config/claude-status.json, and <repo-root>/.config/claude-status.json. Objects merge key by key; arrays and scalars replace wholesale.

autoConfigureRepo.description: When true (the default), a `--statusline` render inside a git repo that has no `<repo-root>/.config/claude-status.json` creates one — migrating a repo-level `statusline.json` if it finds one, otherwise seeding `projectName` from the repo directory name. Set it to `false` in your user config to opt out. Only ever read from the embedded and user layers, only ever acted on by `--statusline`, and silent on any failure.

caps.description: Thresholds the `--caps-hook` PostToolUse actuator measures usage against, as percentages. When one is exceeded the hook injects a directive telling the agent to hand off and stop, once per escalation. Resolved through all three config layers like any other key, so a repo-level file overrides your user one outright — there is no tighten-only clamp. A key that is absent, negative, non-numeric or above 1000 falls back to its shipped default; `0` is a real cap meaning "breach on any usage at all".

context.description: Percent of the context window. Default 65.

fiveHour.description: Percent of the 5-hour rate-limit window. Default 90.

sevenDay.description: Percent of the 7-day rate-limit window. Default 80.

spend.description: Percent of the account's monthly budget. Default 90. Only ever breaches on a seat that has a budget block — team and enterprise — and the figure comes from the spend cache the refresh child maintains, never from a fetch on the hook path. Checked before the other three, because a budget does not reset on a timer.

projectName.description: Project display name shown in the `project` segment (with the `symbols.project` glyph before it). **Repo-level only** — it belongs in `<repo-root>/.config/claude-status.json` and is deliberately absent from the shipped defaults, so a repo that has not set one omits the segment rather than inheriting a name from the user layer. When unset, the segment is omitted.

palette.description: Named colours as 24-bit RGB triples. Referenced by name anywhere a colour is expected.

powerline.description: Powerline divider glyphs (require a Nerd Font).

sepThin.description: Thin divider used when two neighbours share a background.

cap.description: Rounded left cap that opens each line.

thinFg.description: Foreground colour of the thin divider.

defaultFg.description: Foreground colour for segments that don't set their own `fg`.

gauge.description: The fixed-width meter used by the `context` segment.

width.description: Number of blocks in the gauge.

worktreePattern.description: Case-insensitive regex matched against path components to detect a git worktree checkout; the subpath after the matched component feeds the `worktree` segment.

symbols.description: Glyph per data type. Keys consumed by the script: model, context, win5h, win7d, reset, session, cost, spend, duration, project, worktree, folder, branch, ahead, dirtyAdd, dirtyDel, dirtyMix, agent, tokens.

spend.description: The `spend` segment — the account's monthly budget (claude.ai → Settings → Usage), fetched by a detached background refresh into a machine-global cache (~/.cache/ai-plugins/spend.json; override with $AI_PLUGINS_SPEND_CACHE). A render never fetches.

refreshMinutes.description: Minimum minutes between fetches of the OAuth usage endpoint (the file-based timer). 0 disables the background refresh entirely; the segment then renders whatever the cache holds. Default 15.

show.description: `auto` (default) renders only for team/enterprise seats — the plans whose budget is a monthly spend limit. `always` renders whenever budget data exists (e.g. to watch a Pro/Max extra-usage credit cap).

typeSymbols.description: Subagent `type` (lower-cased) -> glyph. `_default` is the fallback for unknown types.

segments.description: Default styling per main-bar segment id (model, context, rl5h, rl7d, session, cost, spend, duration, project, worktree, branch). Overridden inline by an object entry in `lines`.

lines.description: Ordered list of rows; each row is an ordered list of segment entries. A row that resolves to no visible segments is dropped.

subagent.description: Configuration for the subagent panel surface.

descBudgetFraction.description: Fraction of the terminal width allotted to the description before it is truncated.

statuses.description: Status buckets, tried in order. The first whose `match` regex hits the task status wins; an entry with an empty `match` is the fallback for unmatched statuses.

match.description: Case-insensitive regex against the lower-cased task status. Empty string = fallback bucket.

segments.description: Styling for each subagent row segment.

head.description: Status + type glyph head (background comes from the matched status; bg here is ignored).

name.description: The subagent's name (rendered when the task has one).

color.description: A palette name, a hex string (#rgb or #rrggbb), or an RGB triple.

segmentEntry.description: Either a segment id string, or an object that names a segment and overrides its styling.
